It's two AM. You said one more video... forty-seven videos ago.
Your eyes hurt. You have school tomorrow. And you keep scrolling.
Because your feed works like a slot machine.
Most videos are boring. But every few swipes, you hit a really good one.
You never know which swipe it will be. So your brain keeps chasing the next one.
Your brain gets most excited right before the reward. Not after.
And the feed has no bottom. No last page. No natural moment to stop.

text: So that one more video feeling isn't a bug.
